instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium close-up. In a dark dance studio, a group of dancers perform. On the left, the woman in the yellow shirt (R2) stands with eyes closed and arms raised. In the center foreground, the profile man in the rust shirt (R3) has his back turned, arm reaching up. Behind him, the bearded man in the rust shirt (R1) is partially visible, looking down. On the right, the woman in the yellow shirt with a ponytail (R4) looks up and to the right with raised arms. Their hands and arms overlap in a dense, expressive cluster. Soft overhead lighting highlights their forms against the dark background.
